summary: Frontend-only iteration 8 completed. Core Lookbook + Stylist try-on flows are now working in web preview with persisted renders and valid share/save exports; previous runtime-loop regressions were not reproduced.

integration_issues.issue: Observed intermittent file load failure in console (net::ERR_FAILED on one /api/files/.../looks/... path). Retry path worked and exports still succeeded.
Could not fully execute no-image card action matrix in final stable run because no no-image outfit card was available in current visible set.

issues: Dark-mode emulation screenshot was captured, but web preview remained visually close to light theme (likely env/device-theme behavior in preview).

action_items: Investigate intermittent /api/files look image load failures seen on one saved render path, even though retry recovers.
If strict dark mode verification is required, validate on a device/browser setup where system theme toggling is guaranteed.
Run one additional focused pass with a guaranteed no-image card fixture to complete share/save/tag/wear/delete non-render regression matrix.
critical_code_review_comments: TryOnPreview callback stabilization appears effective: no repeated 'Maximum update depth exceeded' loop observed in this run.
No 'nativeEvent.source' undefined crash reproduced during tested visualize/load/retry/export flows.
Flow B backend contract behaved correctly from UI evidence: Save Outfit first then Save Try-On patched same outfit id and preserved occasion.
seed_data_creation: No new users created. Used existing QA account lookbook.tryon.qa@example.com and existing wardrobe/profile fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on public URL with 390x844 mobile viewport. Verified: Flow A persisted same visualization path (stylevault/uploads/user_955795d8bb98/looks/4e77ede8-b358-4dc2-9440-24317b92096e.jpg) through Lookbook and relogin; Flow B save-first then visualize patched same id (d92ee349-0226-45f5-a463-0b0c858bc1f5) and preserved occasion; edit (add-piece) cleared stale try-on/saved-link state in Stylist card. Share + Save exports generated 390x1027 PNG artifacts and were visually inspected.
rca_of_issue: Prior blocking regression (iteration 7) was not reproducible in this cycle. Remaining instability appears to be intermittent file fetch failure on specific look image URLs in web preview (console net::ERR_FAILED), not a render-loop/state recursion issue. Retry path restored the affected card and did not trigger additional /api/outfits/{id}/visualize POST calls in the forced-abort scenario.
